ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Smart City uses your location to mark where the problem you are reporting is. It is used only while you create a report.
ios.ExpoLocationFullAccuracy: Precise location helps the municipality find the exact spot of the problem you report.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Smart City uses the camera so you can photograph the problem you are reporting.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Smart City accesses your photos so you can attach pictures of the problem to your report.
